title: Please welcome our new US citizen

posts.topic_title: Please welcome our new US citizen
posts.author: MichaelH
posts.post_subject: Please welcome our new US citizen
posts.content_md:
By now Andres has been sworn in and is on the way to work as a shiny new US citizen.

I made the following in honor of the occasion.

![Image](http://www.dragonseye.com/blog/uploads/holography/03210005.jpg)

[edited to include: Using 30mW HeNe, H2 on untreated PFG-01 film, 7 second exp, 2min dev in JD-2]

posts.topic_title: Please welcome our new US citizen
posts.author: JohnFP
posts.post_subject: Please welcome our new US citizen
posts.content_md:
Congratulations Andres!!!

I had the pleasure of meeting Andres at the first PCG meeting. He took me into his home and allowed me to sleep there cutting down expenses and the hassle of finding a hotel. He is a very good man. Thanks again Andres! (He also cooks a mean grill ummmm..um).

BTW Michael, Your apple pie looks like a big smiley face with a lot of teeth. Cool hologram.

posts.topic_title: Please welcome our new US citizen
posts.author: MichaelH
posts.post_subject: Please welcome our new US citizen
posts.content_md:
> **JohnFP:** BTW Michael, Your apple pie looks like a big smiley face with a lot of teeth.Cool hologram.

Thanks. Susan thinks it looks a bit like Jack Skellington from Nightmare before Christmas. Being the baker in the family, she made the pie.

> **Kris Meerlo:** very nice hologram, what kind of film or plates are you using?

Thanks. I'm using PFG-01 film, mounted to glass for the master and sandwiched between two glass plates for the copy.
